text:
A knockout chess event for 4 players is drawn as a binary tree. Each player is a leaf, and each match is an internal node, with the final at the root.
(i) How many internal nodes does the tree have? (ii) What is its height, counting the number of levels? (iii) What does the path from a leaf to the root stand for?

points.text: (i) 3, as each match knocks out one player.
(ii) 3, as there are 2 rounds above the level of the players.
(iii) That player’s matches, if they win every one up to the final.
